claims: Ford is recalling nearly 1.4 million 2015–2017 F-150 trucks with 6-speed transmissions due to a faulty sensor.
The faulty sensor can cause unexpected downshifts to first gear.
Unexpected downshifts to first gear can potentially lock rear wheels.
The unexpected downshift issue stems from signal loss between the faulty sensor and powertrain control module.
The unexpected downshift issue has been linked to 444 warranty claims.
The unexpected downshift issue has been linked to 121 field reports.
The unexpected downshift issue has been linked to at least one accident.
